scenarios_harness_source:
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

GUARD = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
results = []


def scenario(name, *, accepted=("accepted", "debt"), refs=("accepted", "pending"), delta="## ADDED Requirements\nr[pending]\n", extra=None, expected=0, diagnostic="verdict=pass", write_baseline=False):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="molten-active-delta-case-") as owned:
        root = pathlib.Path(owned)
        files = {
            ".cairn/specs/project/spec.md": "\n".join(f"r[{item}]" for item in accepted) + "\n",
            ".cairn/changes/change/specs/project/spec.md": delta,
            "src/evidence.rs": "\n".join(f"// r[impl {item}]" for item in refs) + "\n",
            "baseline.txt": "debt\n",
        }
        files.update(extra or {})
        for relative, text in files.items():
            target = root / relative
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(text)
        argv = [str(GUARD), "--root", str(root), "--baseline", str(root / "baseline.txt")]
        if write_baseline:
            argv += ["--write-baseline", str(root / "output.txt")]
        completed = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        output = completed.stdout + completed.stderr
        assert completed.returncode == expected, (name, completed.returncode, output)
        assert diagnostic in output, (name, output)
        if write_baseline:
            assert not (root / "output.txt").exists(), (name, "denied baseline write mutated output")
        results.append({"case": name, "exit_code": completed.returncode, "stdout": completed.stdout, "stderr": completed.stderr})


scenario("pending identity resolves without reducing accepted debt")
scenario("accepted overlap remains accepted", refs=("accepted",), delta="## ADDED Requirements\nr[accepted]\n")
scenario("accepted debt growth remains denied", accepted=("accepted", "debt", "growth"), expected=1, diagnostic="unexpected_missing: growth")
scenario("stale debt remains denied", accepted=("accepted",), expected=1, diagnostic="stale_baseline: debt")
scenario("unknown identity remains denied", refs=("accepted", "unknown"), expected=1, diagnostic="dangling: unknown")
scenario("unknown identity denies baseline write", refs=("accepted", "unknown"), expected=1, diagnostic="cannot write a baseline while dangling references exist", write_baseline=True)
scenario("removed identity no longer resolves", delta="## REMOVED Requirements\nr[pending]\n", expected=1, diagnostic="dangling: pending")
scenario("renamed labels are not definitions", delta="## RENAMED Requirements\nr[pending]\n", expected=1, diagnostic="dangling: pending")
scenario("archive and proposal definitions are excluded", delta="", extra={".cairn/archive/old/specs/project/spec.md": "## ADDED Requirements\nr[pending]\n", ".cairn/changes/change/proposal.md": "r[pending]\n"}, expected=1, diagnostic="dangling: pending")
scenario("modified identity resolves", delta="## MODIFIED Requirements\nr[pending]\n")
print(json.dumps({"cases": results}, indent=2))

import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import sys

source = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
records = []


def run(argv):
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=source, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    record = {"command": [str(arg) for arg in argv], "exit_code": result.returncode, "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr}
    records.append(record)
    if result.returncode:
        print(json.dumps({"records": records}, indent=2))
        raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
    return record


tests = root / "guard-tests"
guard = root / "guard"
run(["rustc", "--edition=2024", "--test", "tools/tracey/inherited_debt_guard.rs", "-o", str(tests)])
run([str(tests), "--nocapture"])
run(["rustc", "--edition=2024", "tools/tracey/inherited_debt_guard.rs", "-o", str(guard)])
cli = run(["python3", str(root.parent / "guard_cli_probe.py"), str(guard)])
scenarios = json.loads(cli["stdout"])
run([str(guard), "--root", ".", "--baseline", "evidence/tracey/inherited-debt-baseline.txt"])
print(json.dumps({"records": records, "cli_scenarios": scenarios}, indent=2))
